text: [image: Ending Reckless Foreign Wars illustration] Ending Reckless Foreign Wars War should be a last resort, not a default tool of foreign policy. Lydia will oppose open-ended military commitments without a clear objective or exit plan, redirect wasted conflict spending to domestic priorities, and restore real diplomacy as the first response, not a box to check before military action already planned. [image: Ending the War in Iran illustration] Ending the War in Iran The U.S. launched airstrikes on Iran without congressional authorization in February 2026. Congress passed a symbolic concurrent resolution against the war, then killed the joint resolution that would have actually carried legal force, the very next day, after direct White House pressure. Lydia will vote for binding legislation, oppose further war funding without authorization, and close the ceasefire loophole the administration is using to sidestep the law. Read More

[image: Restoring Congress's War Power illustration] Restoring Congress's War Power The Constitution gives the power to declare war to Congress, not the President. Lydia will vote for binding resolutions to end unauthorized hostilities, oppose treating old AUMFs as permanent justification for new conflicts, and push Congress to reclaim its constitutional role regardless of who holds the presidency.
